caption: The drawing depicts a two-tiered pedestal stand holding a total of ten lidded containers. The stand and containers are all rendered in a light grayish-white color with golden yellow accents along the rims, bases, and handles. The bottom, larger tier of the stand holds six rounded containers, each with a looped handle on the body and a small knob on the lid, all topped with gold trims. The upper, smaller tier of the stand supports four matching containers, which are identical in shape and decoration to those below. At the top center of the uppermost lid, there is an ornate handle fashioned into a circular shape with decorative flourishes, all highlighted in the same golden color. The drawing is signed in the lower right corner with the name "Harry Mann Waidsel." The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the focus on the tableware.
title: Lazy Susan
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
